verdict.rationale: Docs confirm driveItem versions can be listed via the Graph API and that retention/versioning behavior is configurable (per edit, per save, manual, or never), but no evidence cites a documented restore-version API endpoint or specific default retention windows/duration values. Missing for 10: explicit restore-via-API endpoint documentation, concrete retention window specifics (e.g., default number of versions or days retained), and independent confirmation that restore works reliably.
